firstPlayerRule: Whoever touched calcium carbonate most recently starts.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: The rulebook gives chalk and seashells as examples. Play proceeds clockwise from the selected player.

Distribute starting Energy by turn order: 3, 4, 5, 3 and 4 tokens for the first through fifth players, as applicable. The first three players begin at 0 on the Academic Track; the fourth and fifth begin at 2.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 2, 3, 4, 5, 12. Rendered PDF page 3 (printed 2) supplies the calcium-carbonate criterion, Academic Track positions and the non-monotonic 3/4/5/3/4 Energy allocation. Page 4's Microscope and Flask setup depends on seating after this decision, rather than selecting another starter. Page 5 (printed 4) confirms clockwise turns. Credits on PDF page 12 identify Genius Games and the designers but supply no printing year. The example substances are attributed to the manual rather than asserting that every commercial chalk has the same composition. The PDF was retrieved through the public download for the exact Drive file linked by the publisher.
